list.name: Swamymalai trek
list.where: Starts in Mangalam, behind the resort
list.about: Yelagiri's highest peak, at about 1,320 m. The trail climbs through forest to open rock at the top, with views over the hills and the plains of Tirupattur below. It is roughly 6 km there and back at an easy pace.
list.tip: The trek is managed by the Forest Department and needs a ticket. Carry water, wear good shoes and avoid it in heavy rain.

list.name: Selfie Panda & Chocolate Factory
list.about: Themed photo sets that children love, and a shop selling homemade chocolates in many flavours. It is close by, so it fits in easily before dinner or on the way out.
list.tip: Pick up chocolates here on your last morning to take home.

list.name: Fundera Park
list.about: A bird park with more than 300 exotic birds in large walk-in aviaries. You walk among the birds and can feed some of them at set times. It is one of the most visited places in Yelagiri.
list.tip: Ask at the counter about feeding times when you arrive.

list.name: Cloud Forest Entertainment Park
list.about: Butterfly and flower gardens, a petting area, a fish spa, a large play zone, a short bamboo-forest walk and a suspension bridge with hill views. One ticket covers everything.
list.tip: Plan half a day here if you have young children; there is plenty to keep them busy.

list.name: Punganoor Lake & Boat House
list.about: Yelagiri's main lake, in the middle of the hill town, with rowing and pedal boats and a fountain in the middle. The lakeside park and the Nature Park are right next to it.
list.tip: Weekends get busy and some counters take cash only, so carry some. Stay on for the 7 PM fountain show at the Nature Park.

list.name: Nature Park & fountain show
list.best: From 5 PM, for the 7 PM show
list.about: Landscaped gardens, a greenhouse and walking paths beside Punganoor Lake. Every evening at 7 PM the musical fountain show lights up the park.
list.tip: The fountain show has its own ticket. Arrive a little early for a good spot.

list.name: Lake Zone Adventure Park
list.about: Outdoor adventure activities and games for children and adults. Easy to pair with boating on Punganoor Lake.
list.tip: Check which activities are running when you arrive; some depend on the weather.

list.name: Thrill Valley Adventure Park
list.about: An adventure park with outdoor rides and activities, popular with groups of friends and families with older children.
list.tip: Wear comfortable clothes and closed shoes.

list.name: Wild Waves Theme Park
list.about: A theme park with rides and games for all ages, especially lively on weekends.
list.tip: Weekdays are quieter if you want shorter queues.

list.name: Mountain View Adventure Park
list.about: Zipline, giant swing, archery, target shooting and net cricket, sold as packages from about 1 to 2.5 hours, with views across the hills.
list.tip: Pick a package at the counter based on how much time you have.

list.name: Sivan Temple
list.about: A quiet local temple to Lord Shiva, a short drive from the resort. A peaceful way to start or end the day.

list.name: Murugan (Velavan) Temple
list.about: A hilltop temple to Lord Murugan, reached by a flight of steps, with a large statue at the entrance. The top gives wide views over the hills, especially in the soft evening light.

list.name: Nilavoor View Point
list.about: A cliff-edge viewpoint with sweeping views over the valley and the plains below. Free to visit and much quieter than the lake.
list.tip: Carry a light jacket; it gets breezy at the edge.

list.name: Perumal Temple
list.about: A local temple to Lord Vishnu, visited by families from the villages around Yelagiri.

list.name: AR Thanga Kottai
list.best: Visiting hours 9 AM to 6 PM; mornings are quieter
list.about: A palace-style hotel on 10 acres that is also open to day visitors. Wander through themed photo spots such as the Barque of Rome, the Balcony of Buckingham and the Parthenon, plus a vintage car, waterfalls, Pallava-style caves, a banyan tree over 100 years old, a 150-year-old Thanjavur painting, pedal boats and a kids' play area.
list.tip: Visitors buy an entry ticket at the gate (about ₹350 for adults and ₹200 for children when last checked). The swimming pool is only for hotel guests.

list.name: Jalagamparai Waterfalls
list.where: Below the Yelagiri hills, about 40 km by road
list.about: A forest waterfall below Yelagiri, at its best after the monsoon. The drive down and the short walk to the falls make it a good half-day outing.
list.tip: Carry water and wear shoes with a good grip; rocks near the falls are slippery.
